summary.text:
Compare each pair.

V05: Near-identical. Minor: candidate shows two selected color swatches (black and oak both with borders) vs reference one selected. Very minor. Score 1 or 0.75. Layout matches well. I'd give 1.

V06: Reference shows 2 large images; candidate shows grid with extra row below (4 thumbnails), play icon position differs, missing left bottom menu icon. Scroll position differs slightly but the candidate shows more items. Structure same: overlay, tabs, close X. Differences: candidate shows second row of images, play triangle is white centered vs reference dark circular play button. Minor differences → 0.75.

V07: Nearly identical. 1.

V08: Nearly identical. Candidate shows full stepper visible; reference same. 1.
